extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism ontology after source review; generic introduction-only mechanism claims were removed.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C8-LL-I tested against Staphylococcus aureus cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: C8-LL-I has direct source support for damaging the bacterial cell membrane in S. aureus TEM imaging.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct cellular TEM mechanism evidence is for the representative C8-LL-I analogue; do not generalize as direct proof for every lipidated derivative.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: selected lipopeptides interacting with artificial lipid membrane models
mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD, FTIR, and ITC source sections support membrane interaction/perturbation context for selected lipopeptides in POPC/POPG or DPPC/DPPG model systems.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model membrane assays are mechanistic context, not direct microbial killing mechanism for all compounds.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C8-LL-I, C8-LK6, and C10-ATRA-1 representative lipopeptides
mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM/DLS and simulation materials support self-assembly into fibrillar or micellar structures as mechanism-relevant physicochemical context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Self-assembly evidence should not be promoted to a direct antimicrobial target claim.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: coarse-grained molecular dynamics for selected lipopeptides with DPPG/LysPG/CDL2 bilayers
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Computational membrane simulations support micelle insertion, membrane thinning, and local membrane property changes as model-based mechanism context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational evidence is not a direct cellular assay and is kept separate from the direct TEM claim.
